title: fix(app-shell): the nav gate reads the union of required objects by name in a package-less app, and the app scope asks its areas' required objects (objectui#12980, part 7)
body:
Part of #12980
Clause-②: no

Part 7 of objectui#12980 (claim `6258222825`), implementing the seat's ruling C from the part-6 ACCEPT `6257265150`. This PR leaves the card open.

## What

- **`useNavMemberGates` in an app with no package** (a name, no `_packageId`), while the object type is idle: the gate reads the names-only scope (`readObjectScope({ names })`) over the union of `requiresObject` across the app list the chrome already holds. That means each active app's `navigation` and `areas[].navigation`, plus the app being rendered. Every name any consumer gates is asked by name, so `registered.has || !missing.has` gives the whole registry's answer for:
  - the sidebar (navigation and areas),
  - the landing,
  - the bell's cross-app activity roster.

  The gate no longer reads the whole registry. An app list that requires no object asks nothing and gates nothing.
- **A failed by-name read never hides an entry.** objectui#13009 (`d0934b9`) leaves such a name unanswered: it is in neither `registered` nor `missing`, so its entry shows. That matches how the whole registry's `error` state reads (empty list, everything shown).
- **`readAppObjectScope` collects `requiresObject` from `areas[].navigation` too**, on both the page branch and the package branch, through a module-private `appRequiredObjectNames`. A package app's area entry that requires an object outside the package is now asked by name and gated exactly. Before, it was never asked and always read as registered.
- Unchanged:
  - inside a package app the gate is byte-identical (only the scope's name set grows by the areas' names);
  - outside an app, and once the whole registry is loaded, the gate is as before;
  - `readObjectScope` and `MetadataProvider` are untouched;
  - no new export (the union helper is module-private and reuses the already-exported `navigationNames`).

## Premises measured (Section 1)

- **P1: a nonexistent object answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, not an item-less 200, at the pin `2c9bf9430a`.** Read from objectstack `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` at the pin. `GET /meta/:type/:name` has one absence emitter, `sendMetaItemAbsent`, which answers 404 with `error.code` `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. The answer gate (`createMetaItemAnswer` in `meta-item-read-gate.ts`) refuses `envelope.item == null` as `absent` on the uncached arm. The cached arm's thrown not-found is converted through `thrownAnswerIsBareNotFound`. objectstack's own `meta-item-absent-404.test.ts` at the pin pins this for `object` among other types (section 1, the case named "every type the uncached arm serves answers the same"). So `readItem` records a nonexistent object as an answer with no item, which becomes `missing`, never present. No fork. A local server boot was not done: NOT MEASURED live, reason: the source and the pin's own test answer it.
- **P2: the size of the union, which is the cold per-open by-name GET count.** The showcase and CRM examples carry **0** `requiresObject` at the pin. The console's own apps carry none. The platform's app and navigation producers at the pin carry **17 distinct** names, across the account app, the Setup navigation contributions, approvals, sharing, webhooks and messaging. Command: `git grep -o` for the `requiresObject` key over objectstack `packages/**`, `apps/**` and `examples/**` at the pin, excluding tests, changelogs, dashboards and the spec. One hit in a comment was dropped. A deployment asks only the names its installed apps carry, so 17 is the ceiling for a deployment with all of those plugins installed.

## Tests

New `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/navGateUnionScope-12980.test.tsx` mounts the real `MetadataProvider` and `ExpressionProvider` with a fake adapter:

- **(a)** In a package-less app, no bare `object` call is made, and the by-name calls are exactly the union across both apps' navigation and areas. The sidebar, area, landing and `activityObjectRoster` answers (including another app's entry requiring a missing object) are recorded. The whole registry is then loaded in the same tree and the four answers are asserted equal, side by side.
- **(b)** A by-name read that fails (502) leaves its entry shown, and `checkCapability` answers true. A mount whose whole-registry read fails shows the same entries.
- **(c)** In a package app, an area entry requiring an out-of-package missing object is hidden, and the present one is shown.
- **(d) CONTROL:** a package app with navigation-only entries asks exactly `object?package=app.crm` + `object/legacy_gone` (the part-1 call set) and gates as before. A name nobody asked still reads as registered inside a package app. Outside an app the gate reads the whole registry (`['object']`).

**Ablations** used objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode with a trap restore). No build leg: the mutated modules are imported by relative path from the same package's test.

1. Union dropped: `(packageId || packageless) && metadata` became `packageId && metadata`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `848361e14e13` to `98f657380132`. (a) and (b) went red (`expected [ 'object' ] to not include 'object'`), and (c), (d) and the outside CONTROL stayed green. The restore was proven: blob equals HEAD `848361e14e13`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
2. Areas collection dropped in `appRequiredObjectNames`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `f7b3b87803db` to `7d5785b7a0e8`. (c) went red (`expected [ 'object?package=app.crm' ] to include 'object/area_gone'`), and the other 4 stayed green. The restore was proven: blob equals HEAD `f7b3b87803db`, and the diff is empty.

**Local gates at `1cb9cd1593`:**

- **vitest:** the families naming `useNavMemberGates` / `appObjectScope` / `activityObjectRoster` / `UnifiedSidebar` / `packagelessChromeScope` / `pageRouteObjects-12980` / `objectScope-12811` / `namesOnlyScope` / `scopeReadFailure-13009` plus the new file:
  - `packages/app-shell`: 55 files / 326 tests passed;
  - the 8 matching files outside it (console, layout, i18n, permissions, scripts): 135 tests passed.
- **Type-check:** closure build `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...'` exit 0; `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0.
- **eslint `--no-inline-config`** on the 3 changed source and test files: 0 errors and 12 warnings, all `no-explicit-any` that were already in the base files (2 + 10 at `d0934b9`), so none is new. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so lint is not type-aware and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- **The pre-tsc battery** (all 15 named `check:*`), `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence` and `check:new-line-citations` all exit 0.
- **Declared to CI:** the full `packages/app-shell/` directory and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- The part-6 changeset `.changeset/12980-packageless-chrome-scope.md` (not yet released) says the sidebar's capability gate "still reads the whole registry in such an app". Once this PR lands that sentence is false, and both changesets would ship in the same release notes. That file is outside this part's file surface, so it is left for the seat to amend or drop.
- `useServedViewItems`' package-less branch (part 6) still names only the current app's `navigation` `requiresObject`. It reads `.served` view documents, not a gate, and is unchanged here.
- On an object route or the app root of a package-less app, `AppContent` still reads the whole registry (`readAppObjectScope` returns no scope there), so the gate takes the whole-registry branch on those routes, as before. This PR changes the page routes.
